output.summary: The yield drop is real: Halvard's receiving PPM rose, and the CMM gauge R&R and program were unchanged. The new-operator hypothesis is contradicted, because new and experienced operators reject at similar rates and yield fell before they ran alone. Fatigue, bar hardness spread and spindle wear are confounded in time. Corvane lot order matches the spindle deferral, and no lot has run on a serviced spindle. The scrap-tag timestamps show when tags were written, so they cannot support the fatigue claim. Backlog pressure did cause the service deferrals. Best next step is the staggered spindle service with Tamsworth trials and cycle-counter matching. Do not blame operators or cut inspection. Do not declare a root cause to Halvard yet.
